claims.assertion: Providers must make conformity information publicly available in general service conditions or comparable document, in accessible written and oral forms for the service duration.

sources.evidence: Public information, placement, accessible written and oral modes and availability duration stated expressly.

claims.review_note: Isolated no-history Slovak-language review 24 September 2026: original 'vo všeobecných podmienkach na poskytovanie služby alebo v obdobnom dokumente', literal 'in general conditions for providing the service or similar document'; final wording supported with precision; no dedicated page implied. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: §6(2) original 'vo všeobecných podmienkach na poskytovanie služby alebo v obdobnom dokumente' and 'v písomnej forme a ústnej forme'; literal 'in general conditions for provision of service or a comparable document', 'in written and oral form'. Reviewed wording 'Service accessibility information appears in general terms or equivalent document, in accessible written and oral form'; verdict Supported with precision that terms concern the service and no dedicated page follows from this provision. Final wording in record uses 'general service conditions or comparable document'.

claims.assertion: SOI accepts public reports for its covered product and service remit at podnety@soi.sk.

sources.evidence: Official English contact identifies this as email for submissions intended for SOI.
SOI investigates alleged service noncompliance.

claims.review_note: Official public instructions direct inspection reports and enquiries to its form. Post-draft ordinary-browser pass 24 September 2026 reached https://www.soi.sk/nahlasit-podnet and displayed name, trader, product/service, incident-description and attachment fields, a declaration checkbox, CAPTCHA and submit button, with no error banner in this browser. Its EAA-specific purpose and actual submission were not observed; the form is a general inspection-report intake. No form filled or submitted. Email is general SOI reports, not labelled dedicated EAA. Website says info@soi.sk for information requests; public email distinct from company correspondence. isolated no-history Slovak-to-English language agent, 2026-09-24: §8(2)(b) original 'prešetruje podnety týkajúce sa nesúladu služby s požiadavkami na prístupnosť'; literal 'investigates submissions concerning a service's failure to meet accessibility requirements'. Reviewed 'SOI investigates public reports about noncompliant services'; verdict Correction needed because 'public' is unstated and noncompliance may be alleged. Final research wording: 'SOI investigates reports alleging that a service fails to meet accessibility requirements'; public route audience follows SOI's public reporting instructions, not §8 alone. Requested retry on 24 September 2026: direct ordinary browser again opened the page and displayed a general report form (product/service selector, trader details, description, CAPTCHA, submit button) without an in-browser error; the automated text extraction still displayed an error notice. No fields were submitted, so operational submission and EAA-specific purpose remain unverified.
